Speaking

Ideas That
Move People

Keynotes, workshops, and consulting for leaders ready to go deeper.

Jonna speaks to organizations, communities, and leaders who understand that lasting transformation begins within the individual. Her keynotes draw from her work as an artist, filmmaker, and human development practitioner to create experiences that shift perspective and inspire committed action.

She does not deliver motivational speeches that fade by Monday morning. She delivers insights that change how people see themselves and what becomes possible as a result.

Signature Topics

The Power You Were Born With

An introduction to the Power Reclamation Method and the foundational belief that every person carries the capacity for meaningful change.

Stop Surrendering Authorship

A keynote on how individuals unconsciously give away creative authority over their own lives and how to take it back with intention.

Discipline as the Path to Freedom

A reframe of discipline not as constraint but as the very structure inside which genuine freedom and creative power become possible.

Art, Film, and the Power of Story

Drawing on Jonna's work as an artist and filmmaker, this talk explores how storytelling shapes identity and how we can consciously rewrite the narratives we live by.
